what: reconcile_page_links, a local-only op: the host runs put_page's link and timeline reconciliation for one page a remote writer wrote, held to that writer's grant (outbound edges only, only to existing pages in a write source it reads, none to a private page remote readers cannot see, the page inside its slug fence, timeline entries on the page only); dry_run counts and writes nothing; link reconciliation is atomic: an addLink/removeLink failure rolls back all edge changes and returns auto_links.error (errors is 0 on success); managed timeline backfill publishes through the coordinator against the originally read page identity and revision

upstream.note: Reviewed against upstream v0.60.145.0 (0cd46b7da): remote persistence links effects add plain mentions and remote commits project timeline rows, but no host-only typed reconciliation held to the original writer grant exists. Keep permanent. Managed timeline backfill uses publishManagedPageTimeline with the original page identity, content hash and knowledge revision checked before the coordinator enforces the snapshot revision under the page lock.

hub_uses: serve/remote-links.ts (cosmic-hub #610): after a remote put_page or capture, the gateway queues the page and the drain calls reconcile_page_links with the writer's write source, read grant and slug fence; bin/reconcile-remote-links.ts backfills pages written before
